Container.Name: GridMind
Container.Overview: GridMind is a personal Tesla Powerwall 3 automation and monitoring app. It provides a real-time web dashboard showing solar production, battery state of charge, grid import/export, and home consumption. Create automation rules based on time of day, battery level, home load, and solar forecasts to automatically control your Powerwall's operation mode, backup reserve, and grid charging. Features include free solar forecasting via Open-Meteo, TOU rate optimization, and notifications via email or webhooks (Slack/Discord). All configuration is done through the web UI -- no environment variables required.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the GridMind web interface.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for database, Tesla tokens, and configuration. Back this up to preserve your settings and history.
